# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to make his body somewhat malleable and flexible to avoid
attacks. Gives +5 to DB. The bonus only applies to attacks that the caster
perceives.
@@ 2
The fingers on one of the caster’s hands transform into sharp talons. The
caster can make Small Claw attacks with these talons.
@@ 3
Caster can move one small part of his body to another location. For example,
an eye could be moved to the tip of a finger to look down a small hole, a
finger could be moved to the wrist to untie a rope bond, etc. This spell can
only be used to move a small body part.
@@ 4
Caster’s mouth fills with razor-sharp teeth. Caster may make Small Bite
attacks.
@@ 5
Caster grows a set of large bat-like wings that he can use to fly at 50 feet
per round. While doing so, the caster expends exhaustion points as if moving
at a running pace.
@@ 6
As Talon Fingers I, except caster may make Medium Claw attacks.
@@ 7
Caster grows an 8-inch spine somewhere on his body. Suggested areas include
the forearm, the backhand, or the palm. Caster may make Medium Horn attacks
with the horn.
@@ 8
As Baf Wings, except movement rate is 100 feet per round.
@@ 9
As Viper Jaw I, except caster may make Medium Bite attacks.
@@ 10
Caster’s tongue becomes a 3-foot-long whip that can make a Large Grapple
attack.
@@ 11
One of the caster’s arms transforms into a snake that can make Large Grapple
attacks.
@@ 12
As Minor Body Switch, except that any part of the body (excepting the head)
can be moved to a different location. For example, an arm could be moved to a
place where it could be more useful.
@@ 13
As Talon Fingers I, except caster may make Large Claw attacks.
@@ 14
As Bat wings, except movement rate is 200 feet per round.
@@ 15
As Shifting Defense, except bonus is +10.
@@ 16
As Viper Jaw I, except caster may make Large Bite attacks.
@@ 17
As Horn, except it is coated in poison, and if it inflicts a critical, target
must make an RR versus caster’s level or be paralyzed.
@@ 18
As Snake Arm, except caster can make Huge Grapple attacks.
@@ 19
As Talon Fingers I, except caster may make Huge Claw attacks.
@@ 20
As Bat Wings, except movement rate is 300 feet per round. In addition, anyone
who makes contact with the caster must make a RR or take a ''B'' Heat
critical.
@@ 25
As Viper Jaw I, except caster may make Huge Bite attacks.
@@ 30
Target that meets the caster’s gaze must make an RR or be turned to stone for
1 minute per 5% failure level. Caster can only gaze at one such target per
round.
@@ 50
Caster can make any one of the lower level changes on this list permanent.
Once per year, the caster can choose another effect to make permanent.
